curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with the WDL number and License Express account, then residency, the new-resident deadlines and REAL ID.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per residency or new-resident rule; contrast card for adult versus under-eighteen newcomers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what a newcomer must do and by when.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the WDL-number prerequisite, the two permit ages and the two validity periods.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Permit-age and validity cards; contrast cards for fifteen versus fifteen and a half and one versus two years.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on which permit path and validity period applies.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk the teen requirements: permit time, training course, practice hours, clean record and parent form, then how the license is issued.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Requirement and issuance cards; contrast cards for the practice-hour total and the two temporary licenses.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on whether a described teen may be licensed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Lay out the four adult routes, the supervising-driver experience on the permit route, vision screening and endorsements.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Route cards plus a contrast card for the adult supervising driver.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on adult licensing routes.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the two restricted phases, then the passenger, night-hour and phone limits on the intermediate license.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Restriction cards; contrast cards for the two passenger phases and the two ages.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz applying the intermediate limits to trips.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the violation ladder, the exceptions, how restrictions end at eighteen, and the early warning letter.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Penalty and exception cards; contrast card for the second versus third violation.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what happens after each violation.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach what an agricultural permit allows and what it never replaces.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Two permit cards and a contrast card against the instruction permit.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on agricultural versus instruction permits.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec01-m01..sec01-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
